# Tarnwick Leave Policy

Version 1.0 - Effective 1 January 2024 - Owner: HR Department

# 1. Purpose

This policy explains the paid leave available to full-time Tarnwick employees and how to request it.

# 2. Leave Entitlements

| Leave type | Days per year | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Annual leave | 18 working days | Accrues monthly (1.5 days per month) |
| Sick leave | 8 working days | Medical certificate after 3 consecutive days |
| Casual leave | 6 working days | Max 2 days at a time |
| Maternity leave | 12 weeks | Fully paid |
| Paternity leave | 5 working days | Within 1 month of birth |

# 3. Carry Over

Employees may carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March.

# 4. Requesting Leave

Annual leave must be requested at least 7 calendar days in advance through the PeopleDesk HR portal and approved by your line manager.

Sick leave must be reported to your line manager before 10:00 AM on the first day of absence.

# Tarnwick Resignation and Offboarding Policy

Version 1.1 - Effective 1 July 2026 - Owner: HR Department

## 1. Notice Period
Confirmed employees must give 30 days of written notice. Employees on probation must give 7 days of notice.

## 2. Leave During Notice
Annual leave cannot be used to shorten the notice period unless the line manager agrees in writing. Unused annual leave is not paid out in cash.

## 3. Handover
Before the last day, the employee completes a handover document for their projects and clients, reviewed by their line manager.

The laptop, access card and any other company equipment must be returned on the last working day.
